text:
Type: handwoven kilim rug with fringe
Use: adding pattern and color to a floor; living room, bedroom, dining room, study
Style: traditional, bohemian, rustic
Materials: handwoven wool flatweave, short fringed ends
Colors: cream center, cornflower blue, brick red, olive green, mustard, slate grey
Shape: rectangular, flat, rows of stepped diamond motifs inside layered zigzag borders, fringed short ends, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, vibrant, handcrafted, lively
Goes with: dark or warm wood, leather, terracotta, plants; bohemian, traditional or eclectic rooms

product.name: PERSISK KELIM GASHGAI
product.description: Each rug has its own unique, traditional Persian pattern.
